official: 品川区幼保連携型認定こども園以外の認定こども園の認定の要件に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 提出議案

name: 認定こども園に性暴力防止措置を追加
summary: 現在の条例に、児童対象性暴力等の防止に関する条項を加えます。認定こども園の設置者に、対象となる業務従事者の犯罪事実確認などを行い、性暴力等の防止と発生時の子どもの保護に必要な措置を講じることを求めます。改正後の条例は令和8年12月25日に施行されます。
changes: 児童対象性暴力等の防止と、発生時に子どもを保護するための措置を講じることを義務付ける
一定の環境で子どもと接する業務の従事者について、犯罪事実確認などを義務付ける
第9条第1項の参照先を第6条から第5条に改める
who: 認定こども園の設置者
犯罪事実確認の対象となる業務従事者
why: 法律の改正に伴い、児童対象性暴力等の防止に関する要件を定め、規定を整備するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds sexual violence prevention measures to certified childcare centers
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Requirements for Certifying Certified Centers for Early Childhood Education and Care Other Than Integrated Centers for Early Childhood Education and Care in Shinagawa City
en.summary: The current ordinance will be amended to add provisions on preventing sexual violence against children and related acts. Operators of certified centers for early childhood education and care will be required to conduct criminal record checks and other checks on covered workers, and to take measures needed to prevent sexual violence and related acts and protect children if such acts occur. The amended ordinance will take effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Require measures to prevent sexual violence against children and related acts, and to protect children if such acts occur
Require criminal record checks and other checks for workers whose jobs involve contact with children in certain settings
Change the reference in Article 9, paragraph 1, from Article 6 to Article 5
who: Operators of certified centers for early childhood education and care
Workers whose jobs are subject to criminal record checks
en.why: The City says this is to set requirements for preventing sexual violence against children and related acts, and to update the provisions following an amendment to the law.
